## Review checklist

### Specification review

- [ ] The change satisfies the linked Issue and acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Scope did not expand without approval.
- [ ] Required evidence and human approvals are present.

### Engineering review

- [ ] The change is minimal, understandable, and consistent with accepted ADRs.
- [ ] Relevant focused checks and the repository baseline were run.
- [ ] No credentials, unrelated files, or unclassified large artifacts are included.
- [ ] The change can be reverted cleanly.
